chapter: The rhythm section, family and records
title: Start of the second set of tapes
summary: After a silence, Hinton restarts the recording, noting the date and that they will play Jones's records.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: ...We're still here; this is still January 15, 1973, and my name is Milt Hinton and I'm sitting here interviewing my dear friend and section buddy, Jo Jones, interviewing for posterity. Now, Jo, we've been talking together; we've had a nice talk. This begins our second set of tapes and I think now (we've got some records here of yours) and we'll talk about this very great - the last thing we mentioned in the other tapes was about this rhythm section that has gone down for eternity as the greatest rhythm section that ever was put together, which you were the head - Jo Jones, Walter Page, Count Basie, and Freddie Green . So now, Jo, you got some records here; we should play a couple of tracks... Tell us about this, Jo.
